data.name: PageDescription
data.value: A knowledge path is the story a rep shows on the tablet during a doctor visit: composition, page design, compliance check, MLR approval and release. Only published paths can be used in the field.

data.name: LegacyBadgeTip
data.value: Not bound to a chain — cannot be used in the field.

data.name: LegacyBand
data.value: Unapproved legacy path — it cannot be used in the field until it is bound to a chain.

data.name: BindNoChain
data.value: No published, branched chain exists for this path's subject.

data.name: IdentityNote
data.value: Country and language are the path's identity and never change afterwards; for another country, adapt the path into a new one.

data.name: CreateIntro
data.value: First set the path's identity. The steps come from the chain template you choose; you add contents in the workspace.

data.name: FieldPathNamePlaceholder
data.value: e.g. ALMIBA — HD short reminder path

data.name: NoChains
data.value: No chain can be used: a published chain template with branches is needed.

data.name: CodeNote
data.value: The path code (KP-…) is assigned automatically.

data.name: LanguageNote
data.value: Single-language rule: only contents in this language can be added to the path.

data.name: PreviewNote
data.value: Subject, product, audience and steps come from the chain and cannot be changed.

data.name: CtxChainTip
data.value: The chain is pinned; its branches and steps are the path's skeleton.

data.name: CtxIdentityTip
data.value: The path's identity; for another country, adapt the path (coming soon).

data.name: IntroComposition
data.value: Build the path's story: add contents and approved claims to each step and order them inside the step.

data.name: NextBind
data.value: Next: bind the path to a chain

data.name: NextFillSlots
data.value: Next: fill {0} step(s) that are still short

data.name: NextComplete
data.value: Composition complete — page design comes in a later release.

data.name: HelpBranchText
data.value: A separate story line; branches come from the chain.

data.name: HelpStepText
data.value: A part of the chain. Set required, duration and prerequisite with the gear icon.

data.name: HelpItemsText
data.value: Add knowledge contents and approved claims to a step and drag them to order them inside it.

data.name: SkeletonNote
data.value: Branches and steps come from the chain; they are not added, removed or moved here.

data.name: ReadOnlyNoPermission
data.value: You have no permission to edit; the composition is read-only.

data.name: ReadOnlyNotDraft
data.value: The path is not a draft; the composition is read-only.

data.name: SlotLimitOpen
data.value: At least {0} item(s), no upper limit

data.name: RemoveConfirm
data.value: Remove this item from the step?

data.name: SettingsMinMaxNote
data.value: The minimum / maximum number of items comes from the chain and cannot be edited.

data.name: AddContentNote
data.value: Only published contents in the path's language ({0}) can be added.

data.name: AddClaimNote
data.value: Only claims with an approved version in {0} can be used in the field. The text comes from the approved claim and cannot be changed.

data.name: ClaimNoProduct
data.value: The path has no product; claims cannot be added.

data.name: ClaimPermissionMissing
data.value: You have no permission to see claims.

data.name: ClaimOptionsUnavailable
data.value: Claims cannot be read right now.

data.name: Reason_not_approved
data.value: Not approved in the path's country

data.name: Reason_no_country_version
data.value: No version in the path's country

data.name: Reason_language_mismatch
data.value: No text in the path's language

data.name: Err_chain_template_invalid
data.value: This chain cannot be used: it must be published, not archived and have branches.

data.name: Err_chain_template_required
data.value: This needs a path bound to a chain; bind the path first.

data.name: Err_chain_subject_mismatch
data.value: The chain belongs to another subject than this path.

data.name: Err_path_identity_locked
data.value: Country and language are this path's identity and cannot change; for another country, adapt the path into a new one.

data.name: Err_language_not_in_country
data.value: This language is not a content language of the chosen country.

data.name: Err_reference_set_unavailable
data.value: Country and language lists cannot be read right now; try again later.

data.name: Err_chain_slot_invalid
data.value: This item can only be placed on a step of the path's chain.

data.name: Err_chain_slot_full
data.value: This step already holds its maximum number of items.

data.name: Err_chain_slot_move_forbidden
data.value: An item cannot move to another branch or step; only its order inside the step changes.

data.name: Err_component_language_mismatch
data.value: This content is not in the path's language.

data.name: Err_claim_product_mismatch
data.value: This claim is about another product than the path.

data.name: Err_claim_ref_duplicate
data.value: This claim is already on the path.

data.name: Err_generic
data.value: The action could not be completed.

data.name: Err_unavailable
data.value: The service is not responding right now; try again later.

data.name: WithdrawReviewConfirm
data.value: Withdraw the open review round? The path goes back to draft.

data.name: NextFix
data.value: Next step: fix {0} blocking issue(s), then send for approval

data.name: NextSubmit
data.value: The draft is ready: you can send it for approval

data.name: NextRender
data.value: Next step: create the output of the approved revision

data.name: NextRelease
data.value: Next step: release the approved revision

data.name: NextPublisher
data.value: Approved: a release manager creates the output and releases it

data.name: NextLive
data.value: This version is on the field

data.name: ComplianceIntro
data.value: The rules run while you edit and again as a blocking checklist when you send for approval. Blockers must be fixed before sending; warnings do not stop it. The row button takes you to the item.

data.name: Comp_UnderFix
data.value: Add a content or claim to this step in the composition.

data.name: Comp_OverFix
data.value: Remove the extra item from the step.

data.name: Comp_NotPublishedFix
data.value: Have the content published or remove it from the step.

data.name: Comp_LanguageMsg
data.value: “{0}” is in {1}; the path language is {2}.

data.name: Comp_LanguageFix
data.value: Use the {0} version of the content.

data.name: Comp_ClaimNotApprovedMsg
data.value: {0} is not approved in the path country ({1}).

data.name: Comp_ClaimNotApprovedFix
data.value: Wait for the claim to be approved or remove it from the step.

data.name: Comp_ClaimNoVersionFix
data.value: Request the {0} version in claim management or remove the claim from the step.

data.name: Comp_ClaimLanguageMsg
data.value: {0} has no text in the path language ({1}).

data.name: Comp_ClaimLanguageFix
data.value: Ask for the {0} text in the country version or remove the claim from the step.

data.name: Comp_UnplacedMsg
data.value: “{0}” is not placed on a chain step.

data.name: Comp_UnplacedFix
data.value: Map it to a chain step with the legacy-path wizard, or remove it.

data.name: SubmitIntro
data.value: Sending freezes the current draft as Rev {0} and starts the Medical → Legal → Regulatory flow. The draft stays editable.

data.name: SubmitOpenRound
data.value: Rev {0} is in review ({1}). A new revision can be sent when that round closes.

data.name: SubmitFirstText
data.value: This is the first revision of this path; there is nothing to compare yet.

data.name: SubmitBlocked
data.value: {0} blocking issue(s) must be fixed before sending.

data.name: SubmitBlockedOpen
data.value: A review round is already open.

data.name: SubmitDone
data.value: Sent for approval; the work item is in the Work Center.

data.name: MlrHistoryUnavailable
data.value: The approval history cannot be read right now; decisions are not shown until it is available.

data.name: MlrQueuedNote
data.value: Opens when the previous step is approved.

data.name: MlrPendingNote
data.value: The work item is in the Work Center; the next step opens on a decision.

data.name: MlrRules
data.value: The order is Medical → Legal → Regulatory. Each step opens after the previous approval and lands in the Work Center as a work item. The submitter cannot approve their own path; a rejection needs a reason.

data.name: SingleChannelNote
data.value: One channel: your decision is written to the approval workflow in the Work Center (MOD-0023); a decision given in the Work Center shows here too.

data.name: OutputNoneText
data.value: The archive PDF is created from the approved revision; HTML field presentation follows in a later phase.

data.name: ReleaseNoCandidate
data.value: There is no approved revision waiting for release.

data.name: ReleaseConfirm
data.value: Release v{0}? It becomes the version used on the field.

data.name: ReleaseConfirmReplace
data.value: Release v{0}? It replaces v{1} on the field.

data.name: ReleaseDone
data.value: Released; the path is on the field.

data.name: Pre_artifactNo
data.value: No output: create the archive PDF of the approved revision first.

data.name: Pre_publishedNo
data.value: A content of the path is not published.

data.name: Pre_languageNo
data.value: A content is in another language than the path.

data.name: Pre_claimsNo
data.value: A claim is not usable in the path country / language.

data.name: Pre_conformanceNo
data.value: A chain step is short of / over its items, or a step is not placed.

data.name: Pre_sodNo
data.value: You sent this revision; another person must release it.

data.name: WithdrawNote
data.value: A withdrawn version cannot be chosen in journey stages.

data.name: WithdrawStagesTitle
data.value: First bind these stages to another version:

data.name: RevExplainVersionText
data.value: (v1.0, v2.0) is the released form of the path.

data.name: RevExplainRevisionText
data.value: (Rev 1, 2, 3) is a frozen copy of a version sent for approval. A rejected revision is fixed and sent again, so one version can have several revisions.

data.name: PreviewDraft
data.value: Draft — the output is created after approval.

data.name: PreviewNoOutput
data.value: Approved — the preview appears once the output is created.

data.name: PreviewPdfNote
data.value: The archive PDF of the approved revision; the interactive HTML presentation follows in a later phase.

data.name: UsageNoJourneys
data.value: No journey stage uses this path.

data.name: UsageNoTemplates
data.value: No strategy template is bound to this path.

data.name: UsageViewsLater
data.value: Page views and time per page from the field come in a later phase.

data.name: ReviewerHint
data.value: Click a claim block: its evidence document opens in the side panel.

data.name: ReviewerNoText
data.value: No text in the path language.

data.name: EvidencePick
data.value: Select a claim block to see its evidence.

data.name: EvidenceNone
data.value: No evidence is linked to this claim.

data.name: EvidenceNoPermission
data.value: You do not have permission to read claim evidence.

data.name: EvidenceUnavailable
data.value: The evidence cannot be read right now.

data.name: NotesIntro
data.value: Notes are kept with the revision; unresolved notes carry over to the next revision.

data.name: DecisionCommentPlaceholder
data.value: Optional when approving; required when rejecting

data.name: DecisionRejectNeedsComment
data.value: A rejection needs a reason. Write which step or block must change and how.

data.name: DecisionApproved
data.value: Approval recorded ({0}). The next step opens in the Work Center.

data.name: DecisionRejected
data.value: Rejection recorded. The submitter fixes it and sends a new revision.

data.name: DecisionOwnRevision
data.value: You sent this revision. The submitter cannot decide on their own path.

data.name: DecisionClosed
data.value: This revision has no open review step.

data.name: WizardTitle
data.value: Bind to a chain and send for approval

data.name: WizardChainIntro
data.value: The chain the path is bound to. Product and audience come from the chain; country and language become the path’s identity.

data.name: WizardBindNote
data.value: Once bound, the chain, country and language are fixed for this path.

data.name: WizardMapIntro
data.value: Map each old step onto a chain step. A step without a match is not placed and blocks the approval until it is mapped or removed.

data.name: WizardUnmapped
data.value: {0} step(s) without a chain step: they stay unplaced and block the approval.

data.name: WizardClaimsIntro
data.value: Claims referenced by the contents of the steps. Accept or reject each suggestion.

data.name: WizardClaimsNote
data.value: Nothing is bound automatically: only the claims you accept are added, on the step of the content that referenced them.

data.name: WizardNeedsMapping
data.value: Its step is not mapped, so it cannot be placed; map the step first or reject.

data.name: WizardNoSuggestions
data.value: The step contents reference no claim.

data.name: WizardSummaryNote
data.value: The path is unapproved until its revision is approved: it cannot be used on the field until then. You can send it for approval now or later from the workspace.

data.name: Err_review_round_open
data.value: A review round is already open for this path.

data.name: Err_chain_conformance_failed
data.value: The path does not conform to its chain (a step is short of or over its items).

data.name: Err_component_not_published
data.value: A content of the path is not published.

data.name: Err_claim_no_country_version
data.value: A claim has no version in the path country.

data.name: Err_approval_template_missing
data.value: The approval template of the path country is not set up. Ask the system administrator.

data.name: Err_workflow_unavailable
data.value: The approval workflow is not responding right now; try again later.

data.name: Err_comment_required
data.value: A rejection needs a reason (at most 2000 characters).

data.name: Err_sod_submitter_cannot_decide
data.value: You sent this revision; the submitter cannot decide on it.

data.name: Err_approval_via_workflow_only
data.value: A knowledge path is approved only through its MLR flow, not directly.

data.name: Err_artifact_missing
data.value: There is no output for this revision yet.

data.name: Err_revision_superseded
data.value: A newer revision replaced this one; reload the page.

data.name: Err_revision_not_released
data.value: Only a released revision can be withdrawn.

data.name: Err_sod_submitter_cannot_release
data.value: You sent this revision; another person must release it.

data.name: Err_reason_required
data.value: A reason for the withdrawal is required.

data.name: Err_path_in_use
data.value: A published journey stage uses this path; nothing was withdrawn.

data.name: Err_previous_path_in_use
data.value: The replaced version is still pinned in these journey stages:

data.name: Err_artifact_store_unavailable
data.value: The document store is not responding; the output was not created. Try again later.

data.name: Err_claim_not_approved
data.value: A claim is not approved in the path country.

data.name: Err_claim_language_mismatch
data.value: A claim has no text in the path language.

data.name: Err_approval_forbidden
data.value: You are not a reviewer of this step; the decision belongs to the position assigned in the Work Center.

data.name: Err_no_open_review
data.value: This revision has no waiting review step (it may have just finished).

data.name: Err_note_not_found
data.value: The note was not found; reload the page.

data.name: DecisionApprovedFinal
data.value: Approval recorded. The review is complete.

data.name: Err_withdraw_not_submitter
data.value: Only the person who submitted this review can withdraw it.
